rows.note: This is the all-purpose label for an area where smoking is prohibited.

example.english: This is a non-smoking area, please put out your cigarette.
example.traditional: 呢度係禁煙區，唔該你熄咗支煙。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 gam3 jin1 keoi1 m4 goi1 nei5 sik1 zo2 zi1 jin1

rows.jyutping: m4 zeon2 sik6 jin1 ge3 keoi1
rows.note: Use this colloquial phrasing when explaining the restriction in ordinary conversation.

example.english: The upstairs of this restaurant is a non-smoking area; if you want to smoke, go downstairs.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳樓上係唔准食煙嘅區，你想食煙要落街。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 lau4 soeng6 hai6 m4 zeon2 sik6 jin1 ge3 keoi1 nei5 soeng2 sik6 jin1 jiu3 lok6 gaai1

rows.note: Choose this formal sign-style wording when referring to labelled sections or official notices.

example.english: Passengers are reminded that smoking is not allowed in the non-smoking area of the carriage.
example.traditional: 請乘客留意，車廂內嘅非吸煙區唔准食煙。
example.jyutping: cing2 sing4 haak3 lau4 ji3 ce1 soeng1 noi6 ge3 fei1 kap1 jin1 keoi1 m4 zeon2 sik6 jin1
